newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian bonds steal limelight from N.Z..
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian bonds steal limelight from N.Z..

text.p: An unexpected rate cut by the Reserve Bank of Australia saw bond yields drop and differentials to the U.S. and Canada narrow sharply.

The local market also outpaced New Zealand, which had raced ahead at its opening following Tuesday's news that a coalition government between the National and N.Z. First parties had been finally agreed after two months of negotiation.

The RBA's announcement that it had cut official interest rates by 50 basis points to 6.0 percent saw the 10-year basis point spread to the U.S. dive to the mid-80s, it lowest level since late-October.
However, the move was pared as the local market ran into profit-taking, and amid disappointment that the 10-year bond yield failed to make an attack on the elusive 7.0 percent barrier.
This also saw the local yield curve steepen sharply with the three/10-year bond spread jumping over double figures as the short-end factored in the rate move.
Australia's 10-year spread to New Zealand widened to over 20 basis points before the local rate cut, but by late afternoon the differential had gone to a small discount.
The largest move on the day was against Canada, which gave up some of its recent strong advance and as some of the recent spread narrowing trades to the U.S. were unwound.
